jobs.title: Fulfillment Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States; Princeton, New Jersey, United States
jobs.description:
Noom is on a mission to help people live better, longer. We’re a consumer-led digital health company, connecting people to content, coaching, community, and clinicians, to build lasting habits and live healthier lives. We’re a high-growth organization powered by science, technology, and world-class talent. When you join Noom, on any team, whether fully remote or in one of our offices, you’ll see the impact of your work on the world.

Our Pharmacy Operations Team

Our Pharmacy Ops team is at the heart of Noom's ability to deliver medically sound, scalable health programs. We sit at the intersection of clinical excellence and operational innovation, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Clinical teams to provide our community with high-quality products, efficiently and at scale.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Fulfillment Operations Manager to own the pharmacy and supply chain logistics that keep Noom’s medication and product fulfillment running smoothly. You’ll manage vendor relationships across pharmacy and 3PL partners, oversee inventory and procurement, and ensure GLP-1 kits, diagnostic tools, supplements, and future products are delivered reliably and cost-effectively. You’ll also serve as a key point of coordination between patients, Care Coordinators, and pharmacy partners—resolving order issues and streamlining the systems that support them. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where strategic planning meets day-to-day execution.

You Will

- Manage fulfillment performance across pharmacy and 3PL partners, ensuring SLA adherence and resolving issues quickly

- Oversee the medication order ticketing system, resolving shipment delays, lost or damaged packages, address updates, and replacement orders

- Serve as a liaison between patients, Care Coordinators, and pharmacy representatives, ensuring seamless communication and support across departments

- Maintain accurate, SKU-level inventory visibility across locations and support end-of-month reconciliation

- Forecast demand, manage replenishment cycles, and coordinate inventory transfers to meet order volume

- Analyze large datasets to identify trends and improve inventory and fulfillment strategy

- Support new launches by collaborating with Engineering, Product, and Clinical Ops to ensure operational readiness

- Manage Help Desk tickets via a ticketing system, following up with Care Coordinators to ensure timely resolution

- Help evaluate and implement tools such as an Inventory Management System (IMS) or ERP-lite solution

- Collaborate cross-functionally to improve operational efficiency as Noom Med continues to grow and diversify its offerings

About You

If you’re energized by building scalable systems that bridge healthcare fulfillment with operational excellence, this role is for you.

You Have

- Bachelor’s degree a related field, or equivalent relevant experience

- 4+ years of experience in mature supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, or pharmacy/healthcare operations—ideally in CPG, DTC health, telemedicine, or fast-scaling eCommerce

- Proven ability to analyze large datasets and identify trends

- Comfortable with technology and digital healthcare platforms, with proficiency in pharmacy, supply chain, or inventory management systems

- Working knowledge of medical terminology and a thorough understanding of HIPAA

- Strong self-starter mindset with excellent written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to effectively engage medical professionals, pharmacy representatives, and patients

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively

- Bonus: experience with regulated products (e.g., supplements or pharmaceuticals), including work with vendors, compounding pharmacies, or other healthcare operations handling them.

What Makes This Job Amazing

- You’ll help millions of people lead healthier lives every day

- You’ll architect the supply chain and pharmacy fulfillment systems supporting Noom Med’s next stage of growth

- You’ll collaborate with product, clinical, and operations teams to support innovation at scale

- You’ll join a transparent, high-performing, close-knit team with real opportunity for advancement

What You'll Earn and Enjoy

- Pay that reflects your impact.  Compensation benchmarked to the market and shaped by your impact and value.

- Investment in your future.  A 401(k) with company match to help you build long-term financial security.

- Time to truly recharge.  Paid holidays, generous time off, Summer Fridays, and a company-wide Summer Break week so the whole team can unplug together.

- Care that covers it all.  Access to top-tier medical plans for you and your family, including a premium-free plan option, alongside dental, vision, and life insurance.

- Support for growing families.  Paid parental leave to give you the time and flexibility to focus on what matters most.

- And more to help you thrive.  Stock awards, a performance-based bonus, and exclusive access to Noom's products, so you can grow with us, win with us, and enjoy what we build.

The base salary range for this position is $97,500 - $127,500. Actual compensation is determined by job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role is eligible for our NYC or Princeton office locations, operating on a hybrid schedule (2 days per week on-site).

More About Noom

Noom is a leading whole-person health platform on a mission to help people live better, longer. We combine personalized medication with the science of behavior change and psychology, to help people build lasting habits and live longer, healthier lives. With nationally-recognized, holistic programs spanning weight, diabetes prevention, GLP-1 support, menopause, longevity, and more, we serve millions through health plans, employers, and direct-to-consumer offerings. As a trailblazer in the world of health and wellness, Noom makes healthy living easy, fun, and deeply rewarding.

We're more than a health tech company—we're a movement. This belief extends to our culture: we empower our people to think big, act boldly, and take pride in their contributions to shaping the future of health. We've been named one of the Best Places to Work by Inc., Fortune, Glassdoor, and Quartz—including honors for technology and diversity.

Join us in shaping the future of health.  You'll be part of a passionate, mission-driven team working to make the world a healthier place—one habit at a time.

To help protect against potential hiring scams, please be aware that all email communications from the Noom Talent team and/or hiring managers will come only from an @noom.com email address. Please ignore any messaging or communication from other domains (e.g. @noom.team). Noom will never ask you for personal payment, require you to purchase equipment, conduct an interview process or messaging exchange via Microsoft Teams, or extend a job offer without the completion of a multi-step interview process featuring a combination of phone, Zoom, and in-person interviews, as well as references. If you are unsure about the validity of a Noom job posting on another website, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

You’ll support day-to-day account management, client launches, engagement, and renewals while learning the full client success lifecycle. - Respond to routine client questions and requests in a timely, professional manner.

- Help drive post-launch enrollment and engagement activities.

- Prepare agendas, materials, and follow-up communications for client meetings.

- Learn from experienced teammates. You’ll receive hands-on mentorship while developing the skills needed to grow your career within Client Success.

- Help shape how we scale. You’ll contribute to building and improving the processes that support a growing portfolio of Employer partners.

jobs.title: Healthcare Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Noom is on a mission to help people live better, longer. We’re a consumer-led digital health company, connecting people to content, coaching, community, and clinicians, to build lasting habits and live healthier lives. We’re a high-growth organization powered by science, technology, and world-class talent. When you join Noom, on any team, you’ll see the impact of your work on the world.

Our Legal team

They are the builders behind Noom's boldest moves. As we push into new, highly regulated territory within healthcare, we turn complex regulation into a competitive edge, partnering shoulder-to-shoulder with our Clinical, Finance, Sales, and Strategy teams to help Noom move fast without breaking things.

About the Role

We're seeking a Healthcare Compliance Manager to build and own our compliance program from the ground up. This is a hybrid role split between broader corporate compliance work, including business licensing, contracts monitoring, ADA/nondiscrimination accommodations, and light paralegal support, and Medicare compliance, e.g. monitoring the billing process, fielding compliance questions, and standing up an audit process. You'll also make sure our compliance program is up and running day to day—written policies and procedures, a risk assessment cadence, and employee compliance training.

You Will

- Build and own our compliance approach for Medicare, monitoring the billing process, fielding compliance questions as they arise, and standing up a formal audit process

- Screen employees, contractors, and downstream vendors against OIG/SAM and other federal exclusion lists on an ongoing basis, and help administer required Medicare compliance training (e.g., annual fraud, waste, and abuse training)

- Independently design and run audit plans, serving as a hands-on resource for our billing and clinical teams

- Track audit and monitoring findings through corrective action plans (CAPs) to resolution, and report on remediation status to stakeholders

- Conduct or support periodic enterprise compliance risk assessments and translate the results into a risk-based monitoring and audit work plan

- Field and resolve accommodation requests tied to Medicare nondiscrimination requirements, including limited English proficiency, hearing, and vision accommodations, for beneficiaries

- Monitor our contracts database and take on discrete compliance and paralegal-adjacent projects end-to-end, from scoping through execution

- Develop, maintain, and periodically update the company's written compliance policies and procedures

- Support oversight of delegated vendors and any first-tier, downstream, and related entities (FDRs) involved in delivering Medicare-covered services, consistent with CMS delegation-oversight expectations

- Support general corporate compliance and government filings as needed, partnering closely with our enterprise sales/BD team

- Help maintain a confidential compliance reporting channel (e.g., hotline) and reinforce our non-retaliation policy for good-faith reports

- Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for CMS and other regulator inquiries or audits, coordinating responses with Legal and Clinical leadership

About You

If you're interested in shaping the future of health and scaling a compliance program for a company transforming healthcare, this role may be for you!

You Have

- 4–6 years of general healthcare or corporate compliance experience

- Project management skills, and comfort taking a project from scoping through execution independently

- Experience designing and running audit processes, including building audit plans and following through on execution

- Familiarity with core healthcare fraud and abuse laws (e.g., the Anti-Kickback Statute and False Claims Act) and the elements of an effective compliance program

- Comfort with paralegal-adjacent work such as contract monitoring, license tracking, and government filings (no paralegal license required)

- Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Legal Studies, or a related field (CHC credential or paralegal certificate a plus)

- Medicare/CMS exposure is a plus, but not required

- Nice to have: HIPAA experience, ADA/nondiscrimination, or accommodations experience; OIG/exclusion-list screening or program-integrity experience; experience supporting oversight of delegated vendors/FDRs

What Makes This Job Amazing

- A true ground-floor opportunity to build Noom's healthcare compliance program from the ground up

- Broad, varied scope spanning Medicare, corporate, and overall healthcare compliance, and high visibility across our Finance, Clinical, Sales, and Strategy teams

What You’ll Earn and Enjoy

- Pay that reflects your impact.  Compensation benchmarked to the market and shaped by your impact and value.

- Investment in your future.  A 401(k) with company match to help you build long-term financial security.

- Time to truly recharge.  Paid holidays, generous time off, Summer Fridays, and a company-wide Summer Break week so the whole team can unplug together.

- Care that covers it all.  Access to top-tier medical plans for you and your family, including a premium-free plan option, alongside dental, vision, and life insurance.

- Support for growing families.  Paid parental leave to give you the time and flexibility to focus on what matters most.

- And more to help you thrive.  Stock awards, a performance-based bonus, and exclusive access to Noom’s products, so you can grow with us, win with us, and enjoy what we build.

The base salary range for this position is $107,000 to $126,000. Actual compensation is determined by job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role is eligible for our Princeton, NJ office location, operating on a hybrid schedule (2 days per week on-site).
